risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified performance data, but results show materially lower net income, operating income, motorcycle sales, and LiveWire revenue amid challenging macroeconomic conditions. Extensive legal safe-harbor language and reliance on expected favorable regulatory determinations temper the otherwise detailed disclosure.
